The '''Chorra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Bamula sector/Legends|Bamula sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group known as the [[Chorran shipjacker|Chorran Shipjackers]].<ref name="EOTE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chorra system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-13.<ref name="TEA" />
